tareekh_lahore.folio_note: Two offsets, both real. Folio = PDF index + 3 for pages 26-313, then + 7 for 314 onward. The break is a gap in the source scan, not a misreading: p0313 (folio 316) ends mid description of Mazar Shah Jamal Suhrawardi and p0314 (folio 321) opens mid sentence on Jangli Chiragh Shah, a saint never introduced, so printed folios 317-320 (four leaves) are absent from the PDF. Three workers read + 7 independently across pages 314-375 with clean tens digit transitions. Front matter (pages 3-25, the four contents tables) sits at other offsets and is a separate question. ACTION for Rauf: check whether the Drive PDF is missing leaves or the DLI scan itself is defective.
